summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing a new SQL job designed for collecting daily metrics. The initial review found the code largely correct, with minor suggestions regarding type casting (removing unnecessary `UInt64` conversion in `GetDict`) and confirming that the aggregation engine handled duplicate pair issues correctly.

Performance was noted as fast across most queries, except for session-related data (`device_session_trusted`), which is acceptable given its daily refresh cycle. The job was subsequently tested and confirmed to be functional. A request was made to incorporate this job into the nightly recalculation process.
decisions: The new SQL job for daily metrics collection is approved and deemed functional.
The job needs to be added to the nightly recalculation schedule.
action_items: Test the functionality of the newly created script/job.
Add the metric collection job to the nightly run process.
